1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.d3 Bc5 5.B.strategy: Challenges the active bishop at once and blocks its diagonal to f2. If Black trades, the recapture gives White doubled e-pawns, a structural cost that buys the open f-file and a very firm hold on e4. Offbeat, it gives up the usual pawn build-up in the centre.
